ex.en: Only authorized personnel may enter this area.
ex.zh: 僅限授權人員進入此區。

ex.en: The hospital is short of medical personnel.
ex.zh: 醫院缺乏醫護人員。

ex.en: Please send your resume to Personnel.
ex.zh: 請把履歷寄到人事部。

ex.en: He works in the personnel department.
ex.zh: 他在人事部工作。

ex.en: He was able to put up remarkable performances at the sports competition.
ex.zh: 他在運動會上表現非常出色。

ex.en: I am not very satisfied with today's performance.
ex.zh: 我對我今天的表現不是很滿意。

ex.en: I'm not very pleased with my performance today.
ex.zh: 我對我今天的表現並不是很滿意。

ex.en: When I am in London, I will most probably go catch a few performances.
ex.zh: 我在倫敦的時候，應該會去看一兩場演出。

ex.en: Lately there have been constant dance rehearsals; Performances will be on Friday and Saturday.
ex.zh: 最近一直在排練舞蹈，週五和週六要演出。

ex.en: Employees get a per diem of 60 dollars for meals.
ex.zh: 員工每天有 60 美元的餐費津貼。

ex.en: The per diem covers food and local transportation.
ex.zh: 每日津貼涵蓋餐費和當地交通。

ex.en: When the light is green, cars turning must yield to pedestrians.
ex.zh: 綠燈時，轉彎車輛必須禮讓行人。

ex.en: It was the morning rush hour, and there were a lot of passing pedestrians and cars.
ex.zh: 當時正是早上尖峰時間，路上行人和車輛很多。

ex.en: The interface of this website is somewhat pedestrian, but it’s simple.
ex.zh: 這個網站的介面沒有甚麼新意，但是卻很簡潔。

ex.en: His writing style is rather pedestrian.
ex.zh: 他的文筆相當平淡無奇。

ex.en: The two birds built a nest without a building permit.
ex.zh: 那兩隻鳥沒有建築許可就築了巢。

ex.en: You need a work permit to work in this country.
ex.zh: 在這個國家工作需要工作許可證。

ex.en: If time permits, I'll visit the museum.
ex.zh: 如果時間允許，我會去參觀博物館。

ex.en: Weather permitting, we will leave in an hour.
ex.zh: 天氣允許的話，我們一小時後出發。

ex.en: Do you think Tom will permit Mary to do that?
ex.zh: 你認為湯姆會允許瑪麗這麼做嗎？

ex.en: These rules pertain to all employees.
ex.zh: 這些規定適用於所有員工。

ex.en: Please send me any documents that pertain to the case.
ex.zh: 請把所有和這個案子有關的文件寄給我。
